Designer ingested the Untitled UI Date picker (a single-date picker and a date-range picker with presets, built on react-aria-components, with their calendar, range calendar and cell: 5 files, plus hooks/use-breakpoint.ts) via the ingestion workflow (2 Nov 2026). Checked: components/custom/date-picker (InputDatePicker, a typed segmented field with a calendar, the form field of 2.11) does part of the same job; the other overlap, components/custom/date-range (DateRangeControl), was removed by the designer on 2 Nov 2026 (2026-11-02-01). These are button-triggered pickers with Apply and presets, so not an exact twin of the form field, but the overlap is a 1.7 question left open for the designer, and no caller was migrated. Shipped in components/application/ as ingested, matching the carousel precedent (OVR-012). After ingest: icons on Cancel, Apply and Today (3.12), the dead text-md removed (2.1), font-barlow on the popovers (2.2), doc-site heading overrides (2.7), 40px preset rows (2.16), and the pick held in a draft so Cancel, Escape and a press outside keep the date (1.9). The ingest also raised react-aria to 3.53.1 and react-aria-components to 1.22.1 and made @internationalized/date a direct dependency.
